A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 16-page survey, including Appendix A and Tables A1–A3. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that the only visible difference is the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1 presents a literature survey and conceptual taxonomy. Empirical findings are attributed to cited studies; Appendix A classifies prior systems without reporting original experimental or data-analysis outcomes.

after.justification: v2 retains the same survey and appendix classifications. It reports no original experiments, simulations, user studies or empirical data-analysis results.

M1.justification: The Tool–Analyst–Scientist taxonomy and descriptions of surveyed methods are identical. Neither version introduces an original algorithm or model.

E1.justification: Neither version conducts training or evaluation on datasets. The reviewed scientific domains, tasks and benchmark descriptions are unchanged.

E2.justification: Neither version evaluates baselines against a proposed system. Sections 3–5 and Tables A1–A3 retain the same surveyed methods and comparisons.

E3.justification: No original experimental protocol is presented in either version. Descriptions of evaluation procedures and settings from cited work are identical.

E4.justification: Neither version contains original ablations, robustness tests or error analyses. Appendix A retains the same descriptive summary tables.

E5.justification: Neither version reports original repeated-run statistics, uncertainty estimates or significance tests. Statistical reporting is unchanged.

E6.justification: Reported qualitative findings from cited research and all table entries are identical. No numerical results, rankings or findings are added, removed or corrected.

T1.justification: The informal autonomy taxonomy is unchanged. Neither version contains formal theorems, proofs or mathematical derivations.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction retain identical claims about the three-level taxonomy, scientific-method framing and increasing LLM autonomy. The survey's claimed contributions are unchanged.

C2.justification: Section 6 and the Limitations section are identical, retaining the same interpretations, research challenges and exclusions from the survey's scope.

D1.justification: The survey repository link and Table A3's open-source information are unchanged. No implementation details or reproducibility information are added or revised.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography and positioning around autonomy across the scientific method are identical.

P1.justification: The arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 19 May 2025 to v2 dated 30 August 2025. The title, authors, prose, headings and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–2, Table 1, Tables A1–A3 and the page layout are unchanged. Rendered pages 2–16 are identical; page 1 differs only in the version/date stamp.

improvement.justification: The main text, references, figures, tables and Appendix A are unchanged. Updating the arXiv version/date identification produces no meaningful difference in scientific support, clarity or reproducibility.
